summary: Reconciled the two host-blocked-merge paths onto one shared Core contract (blocked-resumable, one honest message), added the coherence regression test, and switched mapMergeState to a fail-safe allowlist; all gates green and committed.

commits: fbc45df #47: Resolve a host-blocked merge to one contract on both paths (criteria 9-12)
d70304e #47: Map mergeable_state by allowlist so an unknown state never merges (criterion 13)
criteria_closed: 9 — both paths resolve merge_state=blocked to the same (state, reason, category) and the identical message
10 — no false 'completed': auto-merge blocks instead of routing to done, so 'Task completed successfully.' can no longer fire on an unmerged PR
11 — one honest message, true whether or not the Engineer can ever finish the merge ('I'll merge it if the host lets me; otherwise merge it yourself')
12 — new tests/unit/core/host-blocked-merge-contract.test.ts drives both paths on the same status and asserts one contract; genuine-merge and genuine-conflict regressions still green
13 (optional) — mapMergeState is now an allowlist: clean/unstable/has_hooks/behind -> mergeable, unknown/absent -> unknown, everything else (blocked, draft, future states) -> hand off
details.gates: pnpm test:all (2837 unit + 67 integration + 16 e2e) + lint + typecheck + check:exports — all exit 0
details.verification_note: Mutation-tested the new guard: reverting autoMergeNext's needs_human_merge case to { go: 'done' } fails exactly the coherence and no-false-completion assertions, and passes again when restored.
notable_finds: The obvious fix double-messages the owner: blockTask -> deliverBlockedQuestion already posts a ticket comment AND a chat question for an awaiting_human block, so notifyHostBlockedMerge had to be deleted, not kept.

Two GitHub plugin test fixtures set mergeable:true with no mergeable_state, which the allowlist correctly flagged as unknown. Real GitHub always returns mergeable_state, so I made the fixtures faithful rather than weakening the mapping to satisfy an unrealistic mock.
src/cli/bundled/plugin-docs.ts is generated from docs/plugins/** — I edited the bundle first and test:all caught it; fixed at the source and re-ran pnpm docs:bundle.
deliberate_scope_limits: merged / auto_merge_disabled still route to done — those are genuine terminal hand-offs; criterion 10 is scoped to the host-blocked case.
sub_phase intentionally differs per path ('await-review' vs 'auto-merge') — each names where the task genuinely is, and both resumes end in the same place.

Not closed (deserves its own ticket): a formally-approved + green + host-blocked PR with no /approve comment emits no event, so it waits with a misleading 'waiting for review' reminder. It does not loop or rework, and closing it would risk the normal awaiting-required-review path. Issue #46 (CI debounce) also out of scope, as specified.
